patterns.title: AAL2 device-session bootstrap must not require an RLS-protected SELECT
patterns.rootCause: A representation-returning INSERT for a newly bootstrapped device session conflicted with the table's hardened active-session SELECT RLS predicate after successful TOTP authentication.
patterns.prevention: Preserve owner+AAL2 checks and an INSERT with explicit revoked_at:null and Prefer:return=minimal; cover the post-MFA bootstrap and RLS failure boundary.

patterns.title: Imported Lending data must be normalized at runtime
patterns.rootCause: Lending selectors treated unvalidated historical JSON as if TypeScript types had already validated person, entries, dates and numeric fields.
patterns.prevention: Normalize or skip malformed legacy rows at the selector boundary; preserve valid/minimal receivable summary semantics without logging financial payloads.

patterns.title: Shared form controls must not drift into page-specific skins
patterns.rootCause: Default input/control styling diverged across Quick Entry, authentication and editors instead of sharing design-system primitives and semantic tokens.
patterns.prevention: Modify the shared primitive/token owner, inspect sibling consumers and verify Light/Dark, focus, invalid, disabled and relevant responsive states.

patterns.title: CI fan-out should not repeat expensive checks on every UI correction
patterns.rootCause: High-churn pushes and overlapping workflow ownership generated redundant full validation, even where review-ready gates or a single owner were sufficient.
patterns.prevention: Keep core CI and security gates; defer heavy rendered/performance/Windows checks to final review head, cancel superseded runs, and run targeted local preflight first.

patterns.title: Windows packaged backend must boot through its CommonJS bridge
patterns.rootCause: The Electron host appeared alive while its bundled ESM backend failed on a CommonJS require('tty'); setup-path CI bypassed live packaged backend verification.
patterns.prevention: Keep a Node createRequire bridge in the packaged ESM backend, capture sanitized startup errors and validate live backend readiness through real first-run configuration.

patterns.title: Product migration must preserve owner category trees
patterns.rootCause: Schema-v3 product migration rebuilt settings but discarded the persisted expense and income category-tree extensions.
patterns.prevention: Preserve both trees across load/import migration and keep older flat-category documents compatible without rewriting history.

patterns.title: Initial account metadata write must target an unambiguous constraint
patterns.rootCause: PL/pgSQL account_id output variable made ON CONFLICT(owner_user_id, account_id) ambiguous in the revision-zero insert path.
patterns.prevention: Use the named primary-key constraint on conflict and preserve SECURITY INVOKER, owner+AAL2 and 0->1 / 1->2 revision checks.

patterns.title: Durable history audit constraint must admit undo and redo
patterns.rootCause: The audit-log action constraint admitted save/import/backup but not undo/redo already used by canonical history RPCs.
patterns.prevention: Keep audit-action and RPC semantics aligned in forward-only migrations, and test both undo and redo without rewriting financial history.

patterns.title: Vercel plain API functions need an independent supported TS project
patterns.rootCause: Vercel's plain Node function packager could not resolve the root TypeScript 7 project-reference toolchain.
patterns.prevention: Keep the API-local supported compiler, tsconfig without references and separate API dependency/typecheck gate.

patterns.title: Operational upstream outages must not revoke valid auth sessions
patterns.rootCause: Supabase request, timeout and 5xx failures were classified as bad credentials or expired sessions, clearing otherwise valid cookies.
patterns.prevention: Differentiate bounded upstream/unavailable/429 failures from real 401/invalid credentials and preserve browser sessions on operational failures.

patterns.title: Finance document limits must fit deployment request and response budgets
patterns.rootCause: Accepted finance documents could exceed Vercel's 4.5 MB Functions body ceiling and malformed imported nested data reached consumers.
patterns.prevention: Keep shared 4 MiB budget on read/save/import paths and validate nested financial structures before persistence.

patterns.title: Editing loan payments must preserve the linked loan identity
patterns.rootCause: Quick Add recreated edited payment events without loanId so existing installments stopped counting toward loan progress.
patterns.prevention: Carry linked loan identity through edit/delete and derive loan progress from one canonical linked-event helper.

patterns.title: Derived snapshots and receivables must ignore incidental input ordering
patterns.rootCause: Balance baseline relied on array order and Lending Map.set silently overwrote repeated historical persons.
patterns.prevention: Pick latest eligible date explicitly and aggregate duplicated legacy lending identities instead of replacing them.

patterns.title: Recurring and zero-valued settings must use effective state
patterns.rootCause: Dashboard read raw recurring seeds without overrides and used truthy defaults that silently replaced valid 0 budgets or 0% goals.
patterns.prevention: Consume effective recurring items with overrides/custom entries and use nullish defaults; guard zero denominator display.

patterns.title: Finance reporting date must refresh after local midnight
patterns.rootCause: A module-level TODAY constant stayed stale while the application remained open across a local date boundary.
patterns.prevention: Use reactive local-date refresh including tab resume and daylight-saving changes without overwriting an explicitly chosen reporting month.

patterns.title: Production smoke health assertions must follow released identity
patterns.rootCause: A product rename changed the health payload but production smoke still expected the old app name, failing healthy deployments.
patterns.prevention: Keep release smoke's expected app identity synchronized with the published health contract while retaining header and deployment assertions.

patterns.title: Local proxy must preserve browser-facing Origin and Host consistency
patterns.rootCause: Bare Vite API proxy forwarded an upstream Host while browser Origin used the frontend port, causing 403 ORIGIN_MISMATCH on login.
patterns.prevention: Forward the browser-facing host/protocol through the reviewed proxy headers and keep origin enforcement enabled for cookie mutations.

patterns.title: Production API routes must fit the serverless function-count limit
patterns.rootCause: Deploying another standalone API function exceeded Vercel Hobby's serverless function budget and blocked the exact release.
patterns.prevention: Route compatible handlers through reviewed existing functions/rewrite contracts and assert the current deployment function budget.

patterns.title: Lazy page and chunk failures need a recoverable workspace boundary
patterns.rootCause: Suspense handled pending lazy imports but not rejected chunks or page render exceptions, leaving the workspace blank or unrecoverable.
patterns.prevention: Keep page-local ErrorBoundary around route Suspense with retry, navigation recovery and privacy-safe error text.

patterns.title: Domain input semantics must be consistent before persistence
patterns.rootCause: Quick Add, reconciliation, lending attribution, split positivity and loan ranges had UI/server semantic mismatches despite structurally valid input.
patterns.prevention: Validate empty reconciliation versus zero, required lending attribution, positive split parts and bounded loan/settings semantics on both client and server.
